## Checklist

- [ ] The title uses Conventional Commits, for example `feat:` or `fix:`.
- [ ] The change contains no real personal data.
- [ ] Every new image and library version is pinned.
- [ ] Each new dependency is named in the spec, or was agreed first.
- [ ] `make unit` passes.
- [ ] The README is updated if behaviour that users see has changed.
- [ ] Any speed or test claim gives the numbers before and after, and the command.
